en: Black‑and‑white view of a quiet street corner in a European town. In the foreground on the left is a three‑story brick building with a steep slate roof and a decorative gable; a striped fabric awning shades a ground‑floor window or shop entrance opening directly to the sidewalk. The street curves around the corner, bordered by a simple curb and a few pruned trees. Across the street are several detached houses with pitched roofs and fenced gardens, set against a backdrop of trees on a low hill. There are no visible cars; a single tall streetlamp stands at the intersection. The lower edge has a large blank margin typical of printed postcards. No legible signage or other text appears in the image.
